notes.title: EFIR ADVENTURE: MATCHCRAFT is now in EARLY ACCESS!
notes.notes:
Hello!
Unexpectedly for everyone, this day has finally arrived!

First of all, a big thank you to all those who have shown great love and support for Efir Adventure: Matchcraft.

Road map
What are your plans for the future? More blueprints, biomes, enemies? Well... in general, all this and even more. For the first time after launch, we're going to focus on any immediate issues and do quick fixes for a while. Once the game is in a fairly stable state, we will start working on content based on our roadmap (what we want) and community feedback. If you're lucky, the two overlap. You can see the roadmap in the game itself.

Support pack
If you would like to show your support for Efir Adventure: Matchcraft, we have added the [b]Efir Adventure: Matchcraft Supporter Pack[/b] so you can support the continued development of the project.
